accessibility.wcag_level: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text and data labels)
accessibility.data_testids: Every button, input, tab, selector, data cell, stat card, and chart has explicit kebab-case data-testid (e.g. data-testid='run-ttest-button', data-testid='study-upload-input', data-testid='ai-prompt-input')
accessibility.screen_readers: aria-label on icon-only buttons, aria-live='polite' on statistical computing status and AI message streaming
accessibility.color_blind_palettes: Blue (#0284C7), Teal (#0D9488), Amber (#D97706), Violet (#7C3AED), Coral (#E11D48) with secondary shape markers on scatter/survival curves

High-performance medical dataset grid with variable type indicators (Numérico, Categórico, Fecha, Binario), filtering, missing value detection, and CSV/Excel import/export

Conversational biomedical intelligence chat that explains p-values, odds ratios, hazard ratios in medical Spanish and generates auto-narrated clinical summaries
Role-based access matrix for Admin, Investigador Principal, and Capturador de Datos with user invitation modal

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep Spanish (es-ES) as the UI language throughout: 'Estadística Descriptiva', 'Pruebas de Hipótesis', 'Formularios REDCap (CRF)', 'Asistente IA Médico', 'Valor p', 'Intervalo de Confianza (IC 95%)', 'Razón de Momios (OR)', 'Curva de Supervivencia'.

2. Implement genuine Python statistical computing endpoints in backend/routers/stats.py using pandas, numpy, and scipy/scikit-survival equivalents so that real p-values, t-statistics, chi2, F-scores, regression coefficients, and Kaplan-Meier survival probabilities compute accurately.
3. Seed rich pre-loaded clinical datasets: 'Ensayo Clínico CARDIOMED-2026 (N=240 pacientes)', 'Estudio Oncológico ONCO-SURV (Kaplan-Meier survival data)', and 'Registro COVID-Longitud'.
4. Use Recharts for all scientific charts: Kaplan-Meier Survival Step Lines, Boxplots, Correlation Scatter Plots with Trendlines, Distribution Histograms, and Categorical Bar charts with error bars.

5. Ensure the REDCap form creator allows building custom fields, validating numeric ranges (e.g. Presión Sistólica: 60-250 mmHg), and immediately filling records with live data sync to the study dataset.

6. Include the AI Assistant (Julius style) with pre-set clinical prompts: '¿Existe diferencia significativa de supervivencia según el tratamiento?', 'Genera la Tabla 1 para publicación médica', 'Calcula la Odds Ratio de mortalidad en pacientes diabéticos'.
7. Provide role simulation switcher in the top navigation so the user can easily test the UI as Admin, Investigador Principal, or Capturador de Datos.
8. Ensure every button, input, tab trigger, and result table cell has a unique data-testid attribute for robust testing.
